why: 管理页用户列表：余额、桌上筹码、各游戏结回份数
sqlite: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.role, u.created_at, u.last_seen_at, json_extract(w.state, '$.balance') AS balance, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(json_extract(s.value, '$.amount')), 0) FROM json_each(w.state, '$.stakes') AS s) AS on_table, (SELECT json_group_object(g.key, json_extract(g.value, '$.n')) FROM json_each(w.state, '$.career') AS g) AS played FROM users u LEFT JOIN wallets w ON w.user_id = u.id ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id LIMIT ?1
pg: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.role, u.created_at, u.last_seen_at,
(w.state::json->>'balance')::numeric AS balance,
(SELECT COALESCE(SUM((s.value->>'amount')::numeric), 0) FROM json_each(w.state::json->'stakes') AS s) AS on_table,
(SELECT COALESCE(json_object_agg(g.key, g.value->'n')::text, '{}') FROM json_each(w.state::json->'career') AS g) AS played
FROM users u LEFT JOIN wallets w ON w.user_id = u.id
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id LIMIT $1

why: 动态的点赞：参数是 id 的 JSON 数组（先当 text 收：参数类型推成 json 的话 postgres.js 会把字符串再 JSON 编码一次）
sqlite: SELECT item_id, user_id, kind FROM feed_reactions WHERE item_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))
pg: SELECT item_id, user_id, kind FROM feed_reactions WHERE item_id IN (SELECT json_array_elements_text($1::text::json))

why: 好友周榜：每人每个游戏的本周净赢和称号数
sqlite: SELECT w.user_id, u.display_name, u.avatar_json, g.key AS game, CASE WHEN json_extract(g.value, '$.wk') = ?1 THEN json_extract(g.value, '$.wnet') END AS wnet, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(g.value, '$.titles')) AS titles FROM wallets w JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id, json_each(w.state, '$.career') AS g
pg: SELECT w.user_id, u.display_name, u.avatar_json, g.key AS game,
CASE WHEN g.value->>'wk' = $1 THEN (g.value->>'wnet')::numeric END AS wnet,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(g.value->'titles')) AS titles
FROM wallets w JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_each(w.state::json->'career') AS g

why: 报位置：位置没变且没到时间就不写（IS NOT 是不认 NULL 的不等于）
sqlite: UPDATE users SET presence_json = ?1, presence_at = ?2, last_seen_at = ?2 WHERE id = ?3 AND (presence_at <= ?4 OR presence_json IS NULL OR json_extract(presence_json, '$.place') IS NOT ?5 OR json_extract(presence_json, '$.game') IS NOT ?6 OR json_extract(presence_json, '$.room') IS NOT ?7)
pg: UPDATE users SET presence_json = $1, presence_at = $2, last_seen_at = $2
WHERE id = $3 AND (presence_at <= $4
OR presence_json IS NULL
OR (presence_json::json->>'place') IS DISTINCT FROM $5
OR (presence_json::json->>'game') IS DISTINCT FROM $6
OR (presence_json::json->>'room') IS DISTINCT FROM $7)
after: SELECT id, presence_json, presence_at, last_seen_at FROM users ORDER BY id

why: 战绩页：career 原样取出（json 类型保留原文）

why: 管理页：全站最近 10 次调整（SQLite 的逗号连接在 PG 里 ON 看不到 w，改成 LATERAL）
sqlite: SELECT u.username, u.display_name, json_extract(l.value, '$.at') AS at, json_extract(l.value, '$.amount') AS amount, json_extract(l.value, '$.note') AS note, json_extract(l.value, '$.by') AS by FROM wallets w, json_each(w.state, '$.adminLog') l JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 10
pg: SELECT u.username, u.display_name, (l.value->>'at')::numeric AS "at", (l.value->>'amount')::numeric AS amount,
l.value->>'note' AS note, l.value->>'by' AS "by"
FROM wallets w CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_array_elements(w.state::json->'adminLog') AS l JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id
ORDER BY "at" DESC LIMIT 10

why: 今天每个游戏有几个人带过筹码
sqlite: SELECT g.key AS game, COUNT(*) AS n FROM wallets, json_each(state, '$.today.games') AS g WHERE json_extract(state, '$.today.day') = ?1 AND json_extract(g.value, '$.in') > 0 GROUP BY g.key
pg: SELECT g.key AS game, COUNT(*) AS n FROM wallets CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_each(wallets.state::json->'today'->'games') AS g
WHERE wallets.state::json->'today'->>'day' = $1 AND (g.value->>'in')::numeric > 0 GROUP BY g.key

why: 每日统计：全站钱包合计（当天的计数在 today 或 prev 里）
sqlite: SELECT COUNT(*) AS wallets, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CASE WHEN json_extract(state, '$.today.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.today') WHEN json_extract(state, '$.prev.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.prev') END IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(CASE WHEN json_extract(state, '$.today.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.today') WHEN json_extract(state, '$.prev.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.prev') END, '$.relief') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS relief_n, COALESCE(SUM(json_extract(state, '$.balance') + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(json_extract(value, '$.amount')) FROM json_each(state, '$.stakes')), 0)), 0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_extract(state, '$.today.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.today') WHEN json_extract(state, '$.prev.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.prev') END, '$.grant')), 0) AS "grant", COALESCE(SUM(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_extract(state, '$.today.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.today') WHEN json_extract(state, '$.prev.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.prev') END, '$.relief')), 0) AS relief, COALESCE(SUM(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_extract(state, '$.today.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.today') WHEN json_extract(state, '$.prev.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.prev') END, '$.admin')), 0) AS admin FROM wallets
pg: SELECT COUNT(*) AS wallets,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (d->>'relief')::numeric > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS relief_n,
COALESCE(SUM((st->>'balance')::numeric + COALESCE((SELECT SUM((k.value->>'amount')::numeric) FROM json_each(st->'stakes') AS k), 0)), 0) AS total,
COALESCE(SUM((d->>'grant')::numeric), 0) AS "grant",
COALESCE(SUM((d->>'relief')::numeric), 0) AS relief,
COALESCE(SUM((d->>'admin')::numeric), 0) AS admin
FROM (SELECT st, CASE WHEN st->'today'->>'day' = $1 THEN st->'today' WHEN st->'prev'->>'day' = $1 THEN st->'prev' END AS d FROM (SELECT state::json AS st FROM wallets) AS x) AS w

why: 每日统计：按游戏合计（键按字节排，和 SQLite 一样）
sqlite: SELECT g.key AS game, SUM(json_extract(g.value, '$.in')) AS i, SUM(json_extract(g.value, '$.out')) AS o, SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(g.value, '$.in') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p, SUM(json_extract(g.value, '$.back')) AS b, SUM(json_extract(g.value, '$.capped')) AS c FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN json_extract(state, '$.today.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.today') WHEN json_extract(state, '$.prev.day') = ?1 THEN json_extract(state, '$.prev') END AS d FROM wallets) AS w, json_each(w.d, '$.games') AS g WHERE w.d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.key ORDER BY g.key
pg: SELECT g.key AS game, SUM((g.value->>'in')::numeric) AS i, SUM((g.value->>'out')::numeric) AS o,
SUM(CASE WHEN (g.value->>'in')::numeric > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p,
SUM((g.value->>'back')::numeric) AS b, SUM((g.value->>'capped')::numeric) AS c

FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN st->'today'->>'day' = $1 THEN st->'today' WHEN st->'prev'->>'day' = $1 THEN st->'prev' END AS d FROM (SELECT state::json AS st FROM wallets) AS x) AS w CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_each(w.d->'games') AS g
WHERE w.d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.key ORDER BY g.key COLLATE "C"

why: 好友数、发出和收到的请求数：PG 的 SUM 不收布尔
sqlite: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status = 'accepted'), 0) AS friends, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'pending' AND requested_by = ?1), 0) AS outgoing, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'pending' AND requested_by != ?1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE b.blocker = ?1 AND b.blocked = requested_by)), 0) AS incoming FROM friendships WHERE user_a = ?1 OR user_b = ?1
pg: SELECT
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS friends,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' AND requested_by = $1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outgoing,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' AND requested_by != $1
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE b.blocker = $1 AND b.blocked = requested_by) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS incoming
FROM friendships WHERE user_a = $1 OR user_b = $1

why: 搭子计数：DO UPDATE 里不带表名的列在 PG 里有歧义（和 excluded 重名），补上 mates.
sqlite: INSERT INTO mates (lo, hi, game, n, lo_wins, hi_wins, team_n, team_wins, last_op, last_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, 1, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8, ?9) ON CONFLICT (lo, hi, game) DO UPDATE SET n = n + 1, lo_wins = lo_wins + excluded.lo_wins, hi_wins = hi_wins + excluded.hi_wins, team_n = team_n + excluded.team_n, team_wins = team_wins + excluded.team_wins, last_op = excluded.last_op, last_at = excluded.last_at WHERE mates.last_op <> excluded.last_op
pg: INSERT INTO mates (lo, hi, game, n, lo_wins, hi_wins, team_n, team_wins, last_op, last_at)
ON CONFLICT (lo, hi, game) DO UPDATE SET
n = mates.n + 1, lo_wins = mates.lo_wins + excluded.lo_wins, hi_wins = mates.hi_wins + excluded.hi_wins,
team_n = mates.team_n + excluded.team_n, team_wins = mates.team_wins + excluded.team_wins,
last_op = excluded.last_op, last_at = excluded.last_at
WHERE mates.last_op <> excluded.last_op
after: SELECT * FROM mates ORDER BY lo, hi, game

why: 计量按小时累加：同上，补 meter_hourly.

login_attempts, recover_attempts, db_size, updated_at, rows_wallet, rows_live)
ON CONFLICT (hour) DO UPDATE SET

rows_reg = meter_hourly.rows_reg + excluded.rows_reg, rows_auth = meter_hourly.rows_auth + excluded.rows_auth,
rows_save = meter_hourly.rows_save + excluded.rows_save, rows_social = meter_hourly.rows_social + excluded.rows_social,
rows_acct = meter_hourly.rows_acct + excluded.rows_acct, rows_board = meter_hourly.rows_board + excluded.rows_board, rows_sys = meter_hourly.rows_sys + excluded.rows_sys,
rows_wallet = meter_hourly.rows_wallet + excluded.rows_wallet, rows_live = meter_hourly.rows_live + excluded.rows_live,
login_attempts = meter_hourly.login_attempts + excluded.login_attempts,
recover_attempts = meter_hourly.recover_attempts + excluded.recover_attempts,
db_size = CASE WHEN excluded.db_size > 0 THEN excluded.db_size ELSE meter_hourly.db_size END,
updated_at = excluded.updated_at
after: SELECT * FROM meter_hourly ORDER BY hour

sqlite: INSERT INTO rate_counters (key, window_start, count) VALUES (?1, ?2, 1) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET count = CASE WHEN window_start < ?2 THEN 1 ELSE count + 1 END, window_start = ?2 WHERE window_start < ?2 OR count < ?3 RETURNING count
pg: INSERT INTO rate_counters (key, window_start, count) VALUES ($1, $2, 1)
ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET
count = CASE WHEN rate_counters.window_start < $2 THEN 1 ELSE rate_counters.count + 1 END,
window_start = $2
WHERE rate_counters.window_start < $2 OR rate_counters.count < $3
RETURNING count
after: SELECT * FROM rate_counters ORDER BY key

why: 登录失败计数和锁定：同上；1 << n 写成 bigint 左移（SQLite 的整数是 64 位）
sqlite: INSERT INTO rate_counters (key, window_start, count, blocked_until) VALUES (?1, ?2, 1, 0) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET count = CASE WHEN window_start + ?3 <= ?2 THEN 1 ELSE count + 1 END, blocked_until = CASE WHEN window_start + ?3 <= ?2 THEN 0 WHEN count + 1 >= ?4 THEN ?2 + MIN(?5 * (1 << MIN(count + 1 - ?4, 20)), ?6) ELSE 0 END, window_start = CASE WHEN window_start + ?3 <= ?2 THEN ?2 ELSE window_start END WHERE blocked_until <= ?2 OR window_start + ?3 <= ?2 RETURNING blocked_until
pg: INSERT INTO rate_counters (key, window_start, count, blocked_until) VALUES ($1, $2, 1, 0)
ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET
count = CASE WHEN rate_counters.window_start + $3 <= $2 THEN 1 ELSE rate_counters.count + 1 END,
blocked_until = CASE
WHEN rate_counters.window_start + $3 <= $2 THEN 0
WHEN rate_counters.count + 1 >= $4 THEN $2 + LEAST($5 * (1::bigint << LEAST(rate_counters.count + 1 - $4, 20)::int), $6)
ELSE 0 END,
window_start = CASE WHEN rate_counters.window_start + $3 <= $2 THEN $2 ELSE rate_counters.window_start END
WHERE rate_counters.blocked_until <= $2 OR rate_counters.window_start + $3 <= $2
RETURNING blocked_until
after: SELECT * FROM rate_counters ORDER BY key

why: 新建云存档：?5（大小）既是插入值又参与加法，PG 推不出一个类型，写明 bigint
sqlite: INSERT INTO saves (user_id, game_id, slot, rev, data, size, updated_at) SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3, 1, ?4, ?5, ?6 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saves WHERE user_id = ?1 AND game_id = ?2) < ?7 AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size), 0) FROM saves WHERE user_id = ?1) + ?5 <= ?8 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING rev, updated_at
pg: INSERT INTO saves (user_id, game_id, slot, rev, data, size, updated_at)
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saves WHERE user_id = $1 AND game_id = $2) < $7
AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size), 0) FROM saves WHERE user_id = $1) + $5::bigint <= $8
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING rev, updated_at
after: SELECT * FROM saves ORDER BY user_id, game_id, slot
